raw: So yeah, I, I looked at the deployment logs this morning and, you know, basically the API gateway keeps timing out after like 30 seconds, which is, which is way too short for the export job. I think we should bump the timeout to two minutes, no, actually three minutes, and also add a retry with backoff so we don't, we don't hammer the database when it's already under load. Can you take a look at the config and let me know if that makes sense before I push the change?

Hey Priya, um, just wanted to follow up on the, on the design review from yesterday. I think the new onboarding flow looks really good, honestly, but the second screen feels a bit crowded, like there's too much text and the button is kind of hidden at the bottom. Maybe we could split it into two screens, or I mean, at least move the button up. Also, the illustrations are great, but they load slowly on mobile, so we should probably compress them. Let me know what you think.

Okay, so I, I wanted to give everyone a quick update on the Q3 roadmap. We're basically on track for the billing migration, it should be done by the end of September, but the analytics dashboard is going to slip by about two weeks because, you know, we lost a couple of engineers to the security audit. I'm going to, I'm going to talk to the product team tomorrow about which features we can cut to get it back on schedule, and I'll send a summary after that meeting.

Remind me to, to pick up the dry cleaning on Thursday, no wait, Friday, because Thursday I have the dentist at 4, and then also I need to call mom about the, the birthday dinner, like whether we're doing it at the Italian place or at home, and, um, I should book the table if it's the restaurant because they fill up fast on weekends, so maybe do that tonight.

So the bug report says that when you, when you upload a file larger than 50 megabytes, the progress bar just gets stuck at 99% and, like, nothing happens, but if you refresh the page the file is actually there. I think the issue is that the server finishes processing but the web socket message never gets sent back to the client, because, you know, we close the connection too early. We should probably keep the socket open until we get the final acknowledgement.

What do you think about moving the, the team offsite to October instead of November? I, I was looking at the calendar and November has two holidays and, like, half the team is out for Thanksgiving week anyway. October also has better weather, which, you know, matters if we're doing the hiking thing. The only issue is the budget, because we'd need to book the venue in the next two weeks, so we'd have to get approval from finance pretty much right away.
